run_linear_evaluation: run DINOv2 linear evaluation on ImageNet with frozen features and grid search learning rates
create_linear_classifier: create a LinearClassifier module with a frozen feature backbone and configurable number of blocks
setup_linear_classifiers: setup multiple linear classifiers with grid searched learning rates and block configurations for evaluation
evaluate_linear_classifiers: evaluate all linear classifiers on a validation dataset and log top-1 accuracy metrics
test_on_datasets: test the best linear classifier on multiple test datasets with optional class mappings
